title: Fiber-based SORS-SERDS system and chemometrics for the diagnostics and therapy monitoring of psoriasis inflammatory disease in vivo .
summary: In 24 patients measured at baseline and four months, Raman spectra acquired at three skin depths were classified with PCA+LDA trained on visit 1; patient-level leave-one-patient-out sensitivity was at least 85% for psoriasis versus normal skin. The paper reports reduced sensitivity at follow-up as most lesions healed (73%), so this is a narrow diagnostic/monitoring proof of concept, not evidence of relapse prevention.
